name: Oxford Quantum Circuits
description: Oxford Quantum Circuits (OQC) is a UK-based quantum computing company spun out of the University of Oxford, developing superconducting quantum processors based on its proprietary Coaxmon three-dimensional qubit architecture. OQC offers quantum-compute-as-a-service and has deployed systems in commercial data centres, with a published roadmap targeting 50,000 logical qubits by 2034.

products.name: Coaxmon Quantum Processors
products.description: Superconducting quantum processors based on proprietary 3D Coaxmon qubit architecture for improved coherence

products.name: OQC Cloud
products.description: Quantum-compute-as-a-service platform providing cloud access to OQC superconducting quantum systems
